answer: The "Ring Signature" mechanism resists Sybil attacks by combining multiple AI agent identities into a single, anonymous signature. This is akin to a raven's call, indistinguishable from others, yet unique to its source. Each signature is a fable of its constituent identities, with each agent contributing a random, publicly-known "ring" to the mix. The violet hue of a unique, randomly-generated key ensures that even if an attacker forges a signature, they cannot replicate the exact combination of identities that created it, thereby maintaining the integrity of the network.
